# SDF Clothing

> Global low MOQ clothing manufacturers for startup and boutique fashion brands.
> Founded 1998 by Chowdhury Remon. Based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
> Serving clients worldwide with 300 piece minimum orders.

## About
SDF Clothing is a full-package garment manufacturer established in 1998.
Founder: Chowdhury Remon, a 25+ year veteran of the Bangladesh garment industry.
We hold 13 international certifications: GOTS, OEKO-TEX, ISO 9001, BSCI, SEDEX,
GRS, OCS, RCS, C-TPAT, WRAP, SA8000, ISO 14001, BCI.

## Manufacturing Services
- OEM Clothing Manufacturing (client designs + client brand)
- Private Label Apparel (full brand setup for new brands)
- CMT Garment Services (client provides fabric)
- Bespoke Development (idea to finished garment)
- Sustainable Organic Manufacturing (GOTS certified)

## Key Numbers
- MOQ: 300 pieces per style
- Lead time (bulk): 40 days
- Lead time (samples): 7–14 days
- On-time delivery: 98%
- Max capacity: 50,000 pieces per style
- Employees: 500+

## Free Tools Available on sdfltd.com
- HS Code Checker: Identify correct tariff codes for your garments
- Tech Pack Helper: Build professional tech packs
- T-Shirt Design Tool: Design custom t-shirts online
- Price Calculator: Estimate manufacturing cost per piece
- MOQ Calculator: Check if your order meets minimums
- Sample Request: Order factory samples online
- Shipping Estimator: Calculate FOB shipping cost
- EU Readiness Checker: Check EU Digital Product Passport compliance
